duration_model.expr: dur + (minrise + maxrise + minsus + maxsus + mindecay + maxdecay) / 2

description: Iterates the source into a STREAM OF PITCHED PACKETS: mode 1 takes only the SPECTRAL BRIGHTNESS from the source and pitches each packet at the (time-variable) MIDI pitch parameter, enveloping every packet with random rise/sustain/decay drawn between the min/max bounds. (Mode 2 derives packets from the source start, mode 3 from random points within it - uncurated siblings; the separate 'pulser synth' mode is DROPPED on this build - segfaults or writes 0-frame files.) SEED SEMANTICS (pinned): -s0 == -s1 == flag omitted, ALL byte-identical (glibc srand default-state pattern), and every run is reproducible - unseeded pairs 1.2 s apart byte-identical; seeds 5 and 9 give distinct takes reproducible at will. NO clock path. Duration: packets are laid until dur is passed, then the last packet's envelope rings out - outdur = dur + a tail between the min and max envelope sums; the curated expression uses the mean tail ((minrise+maxrise+minsus+maxsus+mindecay+maxdecay)/2), verified +4.0% worst on the pinned row and INPUT-LENGTH-INDEPENDENT (0.3 s and 2.0 s sources render the same 3.236757 s at the same seed). pitch, speed and pscat are breakpoint-capable (each verified against both scalar endpoints at fixed seed); the banner marks everything except dur/seed/min-max bounds as time-variable, but only these three are verified here. Mono input only ('File st2.wav is not of correct type: must be MONO'). Ranges pinned verbatim: pitch 24-96, minrise/maxrise 0.002-0.2, minsus/maxsus 0-0.2, mindecay/maxdecay 0.02-2, speed 0.05-1, scatter 0-1, expr/expd 0.25-4, pscat/ascat 0-1; octav and bend are banner-said 0-1 but 1.5 is ACCEPTED (advisory); maxrise < minrise accepted silently; seed unbounded above (257 accepted).
musical_use: A pitched-grain arpeggiator that borrows only the COLOUR of its source: feed it anything bright (noise, cymbals, speech) and it re-voices that brightness as a stream of enveloped tones at the pitch you script. Breakpoint pitch for melodies and glides - a MIDI envelope IS the tune; breakpoint speed to accelerate from sparse blips (speed 1) into near-granular chatter (speed 0.05); pscat adds reproducible pitch-jitter around the line. The min/max envelope bounds are the articulation: tight rise/decay = plucky mandolin dots, long decays overlapping at fast speed = wash. octav adds sub-octave weight; bend chirps each packet upward. Everything randomised is seed-reproducible - keep params+seed to re-render a take exactly, step the seed for variations. Stereo width: mode 1 output is mono; spread downstream (or see mode 3's width/spacedata, uncurated).

dur.description: Nominal stream duration - packets are placed until dur is passed, then the last envelope rings out (outdur = dur + up to maxrise+maxsus+maxdecay). 0.05 accepted; no upper refusal probed (curated max 3600 as guard - the engine duration cap applies). Required.

pitch.description: MIDI pitch of the packets, CDP-enforced 24 to 96 ('Parameter[2] Value (23.000000) out of range (24.000000 to 96.000000)'). BREAKPOINT-CAPABLE (verified: 48->84 differs from both endpoint renders at fixed seed) - the melody input.

minrise.description: Minimum packet rise time, CDP-enforced 0.002 to 0.2 ('Parameter[3] Value (0.001000) out of range (0.002000 to 0.200000)'). Each packet's rise is drawn between minrise and maxrise. maxrise < minrise is accepted silently - keep them ordered.

maxrise.description: Maximum packet rise time, same enforced range as minrise (parameter 4).

minsus.description: Minimum packet sustain, CDP-enforced 0 to 0.2 (parameter 5; sibling refusal 'Parameter[6] Value (0.250000) out of range (0.000000 to 0.200000)').

maxsus.description: Maximum packet sustain, CDP-enforced 0 to 0.2 ('Parameter[6] Value (0.250000) out of range (0.000000 to 0.200000)').

mindecay.description: Minimum packet decay, CDP-enforced 0.02 to 2 ('Parameter[7] Value (0.010000) out of range (0.020000 to 2.000000)').

maxdecay.description: Maximum packet decay, CDP-enforced 0.02 to 2 ('Parameter[8] Value (2.500000) out of range (0.020000 to 2.000000)'). Dominates the post-dur ring-out tail.

speed.description: Average time between packets, CDP-enforced 0.05 to 1 ('Parameter[9] Value (0.040000) out of range (0.050000 to 1.000000)'). BREAKPOINT-CAPABLE (verified: 0.1->0.9 differs from both endpoints at fixed seed) - the density ramp.

scatter.description: Randomisation of speed, CDP-enforced 0 to 1 ('Parameter[10] Value (1.200000) out of range (0.000000 to 1.000000)'). Seed-reproducible.

expr.description: Rise slope (1 linear, >1 steeper, <1 shallower), CDP-enforced 0.25 to 4 ('Parameter[11] Value (0.200000) out of range (0.250000 to 4.000000)').

expd.description: Decay slope, CDP-enforced 0.25 to 4 ('Parameter[12] Value (4.500000) out of range (0.250000 to 4.000000)').

pscat.description: Random pitch jitter of packets, CDP-enforced 0 to 1 semitone ('Parameter[13] Value (1.500000) out of range (0.000000 to 1.000000)'). BREAKPOINT-CAPABLE (verified: 0->1 differs from both endpoints); -p0 == flagless byte-identical (default 0).

ascat.description: Random amplitude jitter of packets, CDP-enforced 0 to 1 ('Parameter[14] Value (1.500000) out of range (0.000000 to 1.000000)').

octav.description: Lower-octave reinforcement. Banner says 0-1 but -o1.5 is ACCEPTED (advisory bound; curated range keeps the documented intent).

bend.description: Upward pitchbend of packets. Banner says 0-1 but -b1.5 is ACCEPTED (advisory bound).

seed.description: Random seed. -s0 == -s1 == flag omitted (all byte-identical, glibc srand default-state); values >= 2 give distinct reproducible takes (seed 5 twice 1.2 s apart byte-identical; 5 vs 9 differ); 257 accepted (no ceiling probed - banner says 'Integer >=1'). Entry default 5 so renders differ from the trivial default stream. NO clock path - every render is reproducible.

examples.description: Plucky packet stream borrowing a noise source's brightness.
examples.expected_use: Mono source in; ~4 packets/s at middle C. Re-render with the same seed for the identical take.

examples.description: Accelerating melodic gliss with jitter and sub-octave weight.
examples.expected_use: Sparse low blips accelerate into high chatter; pitch/speed/pscat envelopes all verified time-variable.

known_issues: SEED: 0, 1 and omitted are the SAME stream (byte-identical); reproducibility is total (no clock path) - unseeded A/B pairs will always collide. Entry default 5.

Output overshoots dur by the last packet's envelope (tail between the min and max envelope sums; the curated mean-tail model was +4.0% worst on the pinned row). Tail is seed-dependent - budget maxrise+maxsus+maxdecay of slack.
Only pitch, speed and pscat are VERIFIED breakpoint-capable; the banner claims all params except dur/seed/min-max bounds vary over time - unverified claims are left non-capable here.
octav and bend exceed their banner 0-1 ranges silently (1.5 accepted) - curated bounds keep the documented intent.
maxrise < minrise (and analogous inversions) are accepted silently - behavior unpinned, keep bounds ordered.
Mono input only ('File st2.wav is not of correct type: must be MONO'); mono output in this mode.

SIBLING TRAP: 'pulser synth' (the arity-0 partials-data mode) is BROKEN on this build - segfaults (exit 139) or writes 0-frame files; it is dropped, not curated. pulser multi (multi-source) works but is uncurated.
